name: FONBET
note: Official bookmaker of FC Rostov; FONBET wordmark on the upper chest and sleeve of the 2026-27 home shirt. League title partner; the KHL championship carries the FONBET name; also title partner of the Russian Cup. Club-level partner of Metallurg Magnitogorsk from 2022, extended through 2028 (sports.ru, 2025-09-03); logo on the 2026/27 game kit, front and sleeve. Ownership unresolved: The Bell (April 2022) reported that Alexander Udodov became sole owner of Pin-Up.ru and that Fonbet's site then named Pin-Up.ru as its owner, and Stavka.TV (September 2026) repeats that Udodov acquired Fonbet in 2022 - but the same Stavka.TV page, citing the EGRUL register, names AO 'Klir Tsentr' as the founder of licence holder OOO 'Fonkor', and Klir Tsentr's owner is not identified by any opened source (sportclan.ru names a Maxim Kuznetsov but was captcha-walled). Russian media (RIA Novosti via sportliga.com, 2026-03-20) name Valentin Golovanov as Fonbet's 'managing shareholder' (управляющий акционер); beneficial ownership not publicly documented in sources opened. Left unrated until the current controlling owner is identified.
